attributes.name: Rubila
attributes.powers:
When you examine this card, succeed at a Stealth 10 check or encounter this card; the difficult to defeat is increased by 3.

Before you act, you are dealt 1d4+1 Poison damage.

If undefeated, you are dealt 1d4 Poison damage.

If defeated, you may recharge 1d4 random cards from your discard pile.
